notes: EVERY PRINTED PAGE IS NOW NUMBERED. Anything you print carries "Page 1 of 3" at the foot of each sheet — invoices, receipts, payment vouchers, payslips, GRA certificates, the VAT return, your statements, the bank reconciliation and the ledger extract. One-page documents read "Page 1 of 1", and that is on purpose: on a filed record it is the positive statement that nothing came after it, so a bundle that has lost its last sheet can be told apart from one that never had a second page. THREE REPORTS WERE BEING CUT OFF AT THE EDGE OF THE PAPER. The audit log, the opening-balances grid and the group overview were each wider than an A4 sheet. When that happens the columns past the margin are simply not printed — no warning, and nothing on screen to suggest a figure is missing. The audit log was more than half again as wide as the page it was going onto, so its last columns were lost on every print. All three now fit, wrapping a long entry rather than running off the edge. Documents that already printed correctly have been left exactly as they were — their column widths were measured and deliberately not touched. AND A NEW CHECK BEFORE ANY RELEASE: every screen is now measured against the width of an A4 sheet as part of the release process, so a report that would be cut off can no longer reach you. NO DATABASE CHANGE: your books and settings are untouched and this installs straight over the previous version. Please still take a backup first — Backup & Export, Back up now.
